defect.finding: E/N = -0.6735 is the paper's own number: Table 2 (8x8 phase scan), row J2/J1 = 0.00, in arXiv:2607.00398v1 (HTML and PDF), identical in the ACM KDD '26 version (pp. 11028-11037) and in the commented-out earlier draft of Table 2 in the arXiv LaTeX source (sample-sigconf.tex line 563); the J2 = 0 point of Fig. 2(a) (e-print file Fig2_Phase_Diagram_8x8.jpg) digitises to -0.6733 +/- 0.0002 (checks/hqt-figure-readings/digitise_figs.out.txt). No error bar, sample count or iteration count for this point exists in the main text, the LaTeX source including its comments, the figures or the ACM version; the Table 2 caption only says the scan 'uses fewer samples per point than the high-precision benchmark (Table 1)'. The stored -172.416 sits 0.0025 (1.0e-5 per site in S.S units, not 1.3e-5) below the SSE row -172.4134528(51). The print precision is 1e-4 per site: every value in [-0.67349005, -0.67345] rounds to the same '-0.6735', so the printed digits do not place the state below the ground state, and without a sigma they cannot place it above either (RULES 9.4 counts the gap past a relative 1e-8 when no sigma is stated). compute.note: Parameter count is for the PBC 2D RNN with d_h = 256, shared across all L (iterative retraining from L = 6), so scope is the ansatz. Four A100s is stated for the PBC timing runs; per-L wall clock is plotted only (Fig. 7, 8). The step count for this row follows from the schedule formula with the (s, r) named in the verification note but is not printed as a number, so iterations stays null. || route2a 2026-09-24: Run: repository run boundary=periodic, scale s = 4, rate r = 0.475, E/N = -0.673464775 +- 2.31e-5 vs row -0.67346478; the match is unique at 1e-7 or better against the other nine runs of that boundary and size. iterations = 163083 = Adam steps at this size only = step_schedule_exp_decay(L = 8, s = 4, r = 0.475) (num_training_steps accumulates over sizes and global_step is restored from the previous size's checkpoint, so the loop at size L runs exactly the increment). Not counted (pre-training on smaller lattices, iterative retraining): cumulative steps from scratch through L = 8 = 564083 (L = 6 stages 401000). Paper Eq. (6) as printed, s x [C exp(-r(L - L0)) + F] with C = 101e3, F = 2e3, gives 164243; the code's C-term is (1000 + 100000 s), not 101000 s - they agree only at s = 1; the code is what ran. (The existing block quoted Eq. (6) as 's x C exp(-r(L-L0)) + F', a misplaced bracket: the HTML has s x [C exp(...) + F].) samples = 100 per optimisation step (run script 'num_samples = 100  # Batch size', split over the 4 GPUs as ceil(100/4) = 25 per device). CONTRADICTS the existing samples = 10000: 10000 is the final-energy estimate count (Fig. 3/12 captions; script 'num_samples_final_energy_estimate': 10000), not a per-step count; replaced, old value kept here. parameters 791554 checked: Table I shapes give PBC 2(4d_h+4d_sigma)d_h + 2d_h + 4d_h^2 + d_h d_sigma + d_sigma = 791,554 and OBC 2(2d_h x 2d_sigma x d_h) + 2d_h + 2d_h^2 + d_h d_sigma + d_sigma = 1,180,674 at d_h = 256, d_sigma = 2 (exact match); size-independent (weights shared over sites, same network for all L). Also flagged: the code uses LRSchedule_constant(1e-5) for L > 6 where Appendix C prints gamma = 5e-5 (no effect on cost). Confidence medium: iterations are evaluated from the authors' run script at the (s, r) identified by energy matching, not printed. || pass 2026-09-27: evaluation: every step at L = 8 > 6 is C4v-symmetrised (config_step3 copied for each larger L, l_symmetries from --lsym default "1"): each amplitude is the sum over the 8 C4v images (symmetries.py, spin parity off), in the gradient log-amplitudes and in every connected configuration of the local energy; evaluations_per_amplitude 8 (verify/VERIFY.md Part 2 #15 and agent-B.md: with it the repo's per-step timings give 2.8-3.2 TFLOP/s per A100, without it 0.35-0.40). The sampler draws from the unsymmetrised RNN in one autoregressive pass (RNNWF.sample), so proposals_per_sample 1 is not multiplied by the symmetry sum. local_energy all: energy.py tiles every bond and evaluates the network on all flipped configurations, parallel pairs included, then masks them with the sign factor. Adam: sr none. use_complex = 0, float32: complex false. Pre-training on smaller lattices is not in this row's iterations (DATA.md exclusion; agent-B.md gives the cumulative factors).
